demo3_in=[[2]*14 for _ in range(18)]
r3="2 0 2 0 2 2 2 2 0 2 0 2 0 2";r4="2 0 2 0 0 2 2 2 2 2 0 2 0 2"
r5="0 0 0 0 0 2 2 0 2 2 2 0 2 0";r6="0 2 0 2 2 2 0 2 2 0 2 2 2 2"
r14="2 0 2 0 2 0 2 2 2 2 0 2 0 2";r15="2 0 2 0 2 0 0 2 2 2 2 2 0 2"
r16="0 0 0 0 0 0 0 2 2 0 2 2 2 2";r17="0 2 0 2 0 2 2 2 0 2 2 0 2 2"
for i,s in [(3,r3),(4,r4),(5,r5),(6,r6),(14,r14),(15,r15),(16,r16),(17,r17)]:
    demo3_in[i]=[int(x) for x in s.split()]
demo3_out=[r[:] for r in demo3_in]; demo3_out[16][13]=1

def f(g):
    bg=max({c for r in g for c in r}, key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    sp=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(c!=bg and c!=1 for c in r)]
    # contiguous groups
    groups=[];cur=[sp[0]]
    for i in sp[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: groups.append(cur);cur=[i]
    groups.append(cur)
    if len(groups)<2: return [r[:] for r in g]
    counts=[sum(g[i].count(next(c for c in set(g[i]) if c!=bg and c!=1)) for i in grp) for grp in groups]
    special=set(g[sp[0]])-{bg,1}; sc=special.pop()
    defi=counts.index(min(counts)); deficit=abs(counts[0]-counts[1])
    grp=groups[defi]
    # row with longest trailing bg run
    best=None;bl=-1
    for i in grp:
        r=g[i];last=max(j for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==sc)
        run=len(r)-1-last
        if run>bl: bl=run;best=i
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; r=g[best]
    for j in range(len(r)-deficit,len(r)):
        if r[j]==bg: out[best][j]=1
    return out

print(f(demo1_in)==demo1_out, f(demo2_in)==demo2_out, f(demo3_in)==demo3_out)

def solve(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sp=lambda v: v!=bg
    counts=[sum(1 for v in row if sp(v)) for row in g]
    is_band=[counts[r]>=0.25*W for r in range(H)]
    bands=[]; r=0
    while r<H:
        if is_band[r]:
            r0=r
            while r<H and is_band[r]: r+=1
            bands.append((r0,r-1))
        else: r+=1
    flags=set()
    for (a0,a1),(b0,b1) in zip(bands,bands[1:]):
        n=min(a1-a0+1,b1-b0+1)
        for k in range(n):
            ra,rb=a0+k,b0+k
            ea=max((c for c in range(W) if sp(g[ra][c])),default=-1)
            eb=max((c for c in range(W) if sp(g[rb][c])),default=-1)
            # poorer row gets flags; tie -> bottom row
            tgt,src,et,es=(rb,ra,eb,ea) if counts[rb]<=counts[ra] else (ra,rb,ea,eb)
            for c in range(min(ea,eb)+1,W):
                if g[tgt][c]!=g[src][c]:
                    flags.add((tgt,c))
    for (r,c) in flags: g[r][c]=1
    return g

ok=True

        fe=[(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if o[r][c]!=i[r][c]]
        print('  pred flags:',fl,' expected:',fe)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'partial')
